name: Utility Room
description: A cramped maintenance closet: two dented lockers, a metal suitcase somebody left behind, and the cryo-nap pod you just climbed out of.
first_visit: You wake with a stiff neck and the taste of freezer. The cryo-nap pod hisses shut behind you. The utility room is exactly as you left it - two dented lockers, a wall screen, your coffee - except for the dust, the silence, and a metal suitcase that is not yours.

exits.guard_text: The bugrat has nested in the hatch mechanism. It snaps at your ankles until you back off. You will have to deal with it first - one way or another.

random_events: The broken screen on the wall shows a holographic map of some star system.
There is a distant hum of some device.
This starship remembers better days.
The wall screen scrolls an undecipherable error code.

hint.text: A bent wire makes a fine lockpick. Try: unlock locker
Pick up the bent wire, then try the rusty locker.
The bugrat is guarding the hatch. Fight it - or offer it something to eat: give apple to bugrat
The terminal told you the suitcase code: 735. Try: unlock suitcase

hint: The hatch leads east into the corridor.

name: Main Corridor
description: The spine of Deck B. Emergency strips glow amber along the floor. Doors lead off in every direction and a turbolift waits at the far end.

extra.text: The overhead lights are back, bright and steady, and the turbolift panel glows a welcoming green.

exits.lock_text: The storage bay door is locked. It takes an old-fashioned key.
exits.unlock_text: The key turns with a crunch of old grease. The storage bay door slides open.

exits.block_text: The turbolift is dead. No power, no lift.
exits.unblock_text: The turbolift chimes and its doors sigh open. Going up.

random_events: A loose panel rattles somewhere overhead.
The amber floor strips flicker in sequence, pointing at an exit nobody used.
You hear water dripping from an unknown source.

hint.text: Talk to the robot. It knows what happened here.
The storage bay needs a key. Didn't something glint in the bugrat's teeth?
The turbolift needs power. The reactor is in the engine room, beyond the storage bay.

hint: With the power back, the turbolift will take you up to the bridge.

name: Storage Bay
description: Crates and cargo netting, stacked to the ceiling and strapped down with more optimism than skill. A computer terminal is bolted to the wall between two shelves.

exits.lock_text: The engine room door is sealed. A slot beside it wants a maintenance passcard.
exits.unlock_text: You slide the passcard through the slot. The engine room door grinds open on a wave of heat.

random_events: Air conditioning hums softly, then gives up.
Something small shifts inside one of the crates. Probably cargo settling. Probably.
The artificial lights are flickering.

hint.text: The terminal needs its logic chip repaired. A screwdriver would do it: repair chip, then give chip to terminal
The supply crate has a simple lock. Try: unlock crate
The terminal gave you a code for the suitcase back in the utility room.

hint: The engine room is through the door to the west.

name: Hydroponics Bay
description: A lush greenhouse under grow-lamps, loud with the trickle of irrigation. The plants have had three unsupervised days and have made the most of them. A hulking replicator squats among the tomato vines.
random_events: It starts to rain - the sprinklers, right on schedule.
A gentle breeze from the vents rustles the leaves.
One of the tomato plants appears to turn toward you. You decide not to think about it.

hint.text: That coolant canister looks useful for anything that is running too hot.
The replicator copies things, badly. Give it something and see: give apple to replicator
The specimen in the glass container might interest the replicator.

hint: Nothing more to do here. Enjoy the greenery.

name: Engine Room
description: Heat rolls off the walls. The reactor sits cold and dark in its cradle, an empty socket where its fission relay should be.

extra.text: The reactor turns in its cradle with a deep, contented thrum. Blue light spills across the deck plates.
The coolant loop ticks over smoothly. She is as healthy as she has been in years.

random_events: A pipe ticks as it cools.
Somewhere a relief valve wheezes.
The deck plates are warm through your boots.

hint.text: The droid is overheating. Cool it down (give coolant to droid) or fight it - better armed and armoured than you are now.
The reactor has an empty relay socket. Try: use relay on reactor
The reactor runs, but hot. Coolant would steady it - if you have any left.

hint: The reactor is running. Head for the turbolift.

name: Bridge
description: The bridge of the Marigold: a horseshoe of consoles under a wide viewport. A blue-green planet fills the lower half of the view, rather closer than a planet ought to be.

exits.leave_text: A red light above the airlock reads VACUUM. Without a sealed suit you would last about as long as your excuses.

random_events: The control panels beep softly to one another.
The planet turns below, serene and enormous.
The bridge is quiet, with only the sound of your own breathing.

hint.text: Talk to the ship's AI. She will lay out your options.
For the escape pod, ask the AI to authorize it - and you will need a sealed spacesuit to cross the pod bay.

hint: Three ways off: the pod (sealed suit, east), a distress call (use a working communicator on the console), or flying home (stable reactor, and read the manual).

name: Crew Quarters
description: Two rows of bunks, hastily abandoned. Blankets trail on the floor, a mug has rolled under a bed, and a footlocker sits at the end of the captain's bunk.
random_events: A reading lamp buzzes over an empty bunk.
Someone left in the middle of a card game. They were losing.

hint.text: A pilot ought to read the manual: read manual
The footlocker is rusted shut. A crowbar would persuade it: use crowbar on footlocker

hint: The research paper explains more of what happened here.

name: Pod Bay
description: Your breath is loud inside the helmet. The pod bay is open to space along one wall, stars wheeling slowly past. A single escape pod sits in its launch cradle.
random_events: Frost glitters on the launch rails.
The planet slides past the open bay, close enough to make out weather.

hint.text: The pod will not launch without the AI's authorization. Ask her on the bridge.
